crossRefs.note: For wisdom will enter into your heart. Knowledge will be pleasant to your soul.
Discretion will watch over you. Understanding will keep you,
I love those who love me. Those who seek me diligently will find me.
“Now therefore, my sons, listen to me, for blessed are those who keep my ways.
A man who isolates himself pursues selfishness, and defies all sound judgment.
Let me understand the teaching of your precepts! Then I will meditate on your wondrous works.
How I love your law! It is my meditation all day.
and with all deception of wickedness for those who are being lost, because they didn’t receive the love of the truth…
and say, “How I have hated instruction, and my heart despised reproof;
neither have I obeyed the voice of my teachers, nor turned my ear to those who instructed me!
One who corrects a mocker invites insult. One who reproves a wicked man invites abuse.
Don’t reprove a scoffer, lest he hate you. Reprove a wise person, and he will love you.
Don’t be like the horse, or like the mule, which have no understanding, who are controlled by bit and bridle, or else…
A senseless man doesn’t know, neither does a fool understand this:
The ox knows his owner, and the donkey his master’s crib; but Israel doesn’t know. My people don’t consider.”

translations.web: Whoever loves correction loves knowledge, but he who hates reproof is stupid.
translations.bsb: Whoever loves discipline loves knowledge, but he who hates correction is stupid.
translations.kjv: Whoso loveth instruction loveth knowledge: but he that hateth reproof is brutish.
translations.asv: Whoso loveth correction loveth knowledge; But he that hateth reproof is brutish.
